sermon.title: Terrorism: Cause and Cure
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In “Terrorism: Cause and Cure,” Pastor David G. Kincer questions the FBI definition when laws or policies themselves harm, then names three sources: God’s appointed terror for breaking His covenant (Leviticus 26), government that uses the sword against good people (Romans 13 misused), and bullies/gangsters. He lists American examples—abortion, approved same-sex lifestyle, and Bible-bashing—and offers cures: obey God’s word, change bad laws or hide until change, and punish those who refuse correction (Genesis 9:6).
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. HIGHLY SENSITIVE/political: names Democrats/Republicans, judges, liberals, humanists, homosexual activists, religionists, atheists as terrorists in his examples; abortion methods; same-sex public display “back in the closet”; Idi Amin, Stalin, Hitler, Quran/force; personal note government cited Romans 13 on him. Kept as spoken. Stats (10M infectious 1860-90, 300M smallpox 1800s, Stalin 50M, 1.7M/20k AIDS, 60+ CA homosexual judges/Prop 8) unverified. Caption fixes: cerse→coerce; ed amin→Idi Amin; samex→same-sex; wasn’t gone→wasn’t God; find us→fine us; Isaiah 269→26:9; 2 Corinthians.→5:11.

With my soul I have desired You in the night, Yes, by my spirit within me I will seek You early; For when Your judgments are in the earth, The inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

faqs.question: What three intents does the FBI list?
faqs.answer: Intimidate/coerce a civilian population, affect government policy, or intimidate government by mass destruction, assassination or kidnapping.

faqs.question: Were Hitler’s would-be assassins the terrorists?
faqs.answer: He asks that question and says it depends on the moral factor—what is right.

faqs.question: What does Leviticus 26 say God appoints for disobedience?
faqs.answer: Terror—including disease, war, famine, beasts, cowardly heart and scattering.

scriptures.text_nkjv: I also will do this to you: I will even appoint terror over you, wasting disease and fever which shall consume the eyes and cause sorrow of heart. And you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

faqs.question: Must Christians always submit under Romans 13?
faqs.answer: No. He says when government punishes good and honors evil it is not doing its job and we are not to submit out of context; they cited Romans 13 on him in court.

scriptures.text_nkjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to evil. Do you want to be unafraid of the authority? Do what is good, and you will have praise from the same. For he is God’s minister to you for good. But if you do evil, be afraid; for he does not bear the sword in vain; for he is God’s minister, an avenger to execute wrath on him who practices evil.

faqs.question: What does Isaiah 10:1 warn about?
faqs.answer: Woe to those who make unrighteous decrees and oppressive judgments that turn the needy and moral aside from justice.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, Who write misfortune, Which they have prescribed

faqs.question: Does he say women can be terrorists too?
faqs.answer: Yes—he says don’t think women aren’t a source, citing tears, nagging, interrogation and withholding sex to force compliance.

faqs.question: Do babies have a right to life in his argument?
faqs.answer: He says babies have equal constitutional rights to life, not just the mother; adults may choose self-control, babies can’t choose.

faqs.question: Does he say there is a homosexual gene?
faqs.answer: He says science has proven there is no homosexual gene—they were not born that way, they chose.

faqs.question: What does he say about Proposition 8 in California?
faqs.answer: He says one homosexual judge overturned the people’s vote that marriage is between a man and a woman.

faqs.question: What responsibility does Genesis 9:6 give mankind?
faqs.answer: Whoever sheds man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed—deal with immoral people; don’t blame God for problems we won’t address.
